sentences.text: Michelin Guides -LRB- -LSB- ɡid miʃ.lɛ̃ -RSB- -RRB- are a series of guide books published by the French company Michelin for more than a century .	Michelin	Michelin

The term normally refers to the annually published Michelin Red Guide , the oldest European hotel and restaurant reference guide , which awards Michelin stars for excellence to a select few establishments .	Michelin	Michelin
The acquisition or loss of a star can have dramatic effects on the success of a restaurant .
Michelin also publishes a series of general guides to countries .	Michelin	Michelin
